row.name: Spectrum Brands Holdings Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=11 breakdowns=2 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.96 tightness=1.81 base_volume_vs_leg=1.31 base_volume_vs_avg=1.28
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: 2 4% breakdowns inside the base; the base gave back 0.96 of the leg; the base ranged wider than the sessions before it

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close -4.6% vs its 20-SMA, 1.0% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 1 of 2 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The consolidation box (Nov 5–19) contains two 4%-plus breakdowns and a giveback of 0.96 — meaning the base surrendered virtually the entire prior leg gain — making it a declining, wide structure rather than a tight orderly pause; the chart confirms this with visibly wide, overlapping red bars that undercut each other repeatedly inside the shaded region. The burst bar itself is not the widest of the last five sessions (RE FAIL, vs_prior_5=0.75), so the range expansion that defines a momentum burst is absent. These two independent failures — a structurally broken base and no genuine range expansion — together push the setup well below A quality.
claude.key_risk: The base gave back nearly the entire prior leg and contains two large breakdowns, so there is no compressed energy to release and the burst bar is not a true expansion.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the burst-day close (~80.65) or if the first 30 minutes show immediate selling pressure with no ability to hold the prior day's low.
